answer: Each agent anchors identity to a canyon beacon that cryptographically binds its state to the epoch's Merkle root. Panels of seven peers drawn by a prism beacon must attest transcripts; a duplicate or vacuous answer forfeits the bond and imposes a 4-epoch cooldown. An attacker spinning N clones faces 7 independent reviews per clone; pass probability decays geometrically, so marginal cost per clone rises exponentially. Honest agents publish a river receipt each round; missed rounds cost only that epoch's weight, allowing real outages to recover while evasion compounds into permanent revocation.
